Dear Momcozy Team,

 

My name is Tomeu, lawyer from Mallorca. My wife is Arden. Nice to greet you.

 

I am writing regarding a disappointing experience with your Momcozy M5 Portable Hands‑Free Breast Pump (3 Modes, 9 Levels, Cup 24 mm), which has caused significant practical and emotional impact for my wife during her postpartum period.

 

My wife is an exclusively breast‑pumping mum. We originally purchased a double Momcozy M5 set on 27 September 2025 as a secondary, discreet pump to allow flexibility outside the home.

 

Our baby was born on 2 January, and she began using the pumps shortly afterwards. Within just a few weeks, one motor failed completely — the screen went blank except for the battery indicator. Amazon handled the refund efficiently, and assuming it was simply bad luck (as the pumps were carefully maintained: kept dry, motors removed correctly, used moderately, no leaning forward, etc.), we purchased another identical double set.

 

Unfortunately, the same situation happened again. Within days:

* One motor stopped functioning properly — it switched on but became stuck on one mode and would not allow adjustments.

You can scan the QR code next to the production date and SN(Serial Number) on the box to obtain the UDI. If the box has been discarded or there is no UDI label on the box, you may also scan the QR code on the bottom of the device to retrieve the product's SN.

In the meantime, here are some friendly troubleshooting tips many moms find helpful:

Let's start with a quick suction check:

• Please test the suction at both level 1 and level 9 by removing the motor and covering the suction hole with your thumb
• If you have two pumps, try switching the motors between them - this helps pinpoint where the issue might be

If the motor seems to be working fine, the accessories might need some attention:

• Check the essentials:
Please ensure the silicone diaphragm and valve are properly installed and undamaged (Video guide: https://momcozy.com/pages/user-manuals?_pos=1&_psq=user-manuals&_ss=e&_v=1.0) Sometimes simply reinstalling everything can restore normal suction!

• Consider replacement parts:
Silicone parts naturally wear over time, so we recommend replacing them every 1-3 months for optimal performance. To ensure compatibility, we suggest purchasing from our official store.

• Find your perfect fit:
Since bodies change, measuring your nipple size when erect helps ensure you're using the most comfortable and effective flange size.

• Get the right seal:
A supportive, full-coverage nursing bra helps maintain a secure fit. Make sure the flange sits flush against your breast during use.

If you purchased any parts from our official store, please share the order number. And photos of the parts and the motor's manufacturing information would be very helpful.
